## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce

```bash
# Minimal commands to reproduce the issue
maknoon ...
```

## Expected behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behaviour

What actually happened. Include the full error output.

## Environment

- **Maknoon version**: (`maknoon --version`)
- **OS / arch**: (e.g. macOS arm64, Linux amd64)
- **Installed via**: brew / binary / built from source

## Logs

If applicable, paste relevant log output (use `--trace` for verbose output):

```
maknoon --trace <command>
```

> **Security note**: If this bug has security implications, please follow the [responsible disclosure process](../SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue.
